name: yf_analyst_price_targets
description:
Analyst 12-month price targets for one stock from Yahoo Finance (yfinance analyst_price_targets).
Returns: {symbol, targets: {current, high, low, mean, median}}; an empty object when Yahoo has none.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Ratings: yf_recommendations, yf_upgrades_downgrades; other sources: fmp_price_target_summary. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "NVDA"}
